messages:
maya (PM): folks — quick sync: I pushed a compact spec draft for a combined review: chat/completions output controls, embeddings stability flags, and rerank batch behavior. can we do a quick pass today? :eyes:

arjun (eng): saw it, thanks. main concern is breaking change surface. are we planning to bump API version or make new optional params?

maya (PM): prefer optional params + migration window (30d) to avoid client churn. only version bump if we change response shape.

nina (ml): from a model standpoint we need two acceptance checks: 1) embeddings mean-cosine drift < 0.03 on our eval set after quantization changes, 2) rerank top-1/ndcg within 2% of baseline for canonical prompts. both must pass before rollout.

eli (design): UX note — for chat/completions we should add explicit "rich_metadata" toggle (default off) to avoid unexpectedly larger responses breaking parsers. Also add example payloads for streaming vs non-streaming.

arjun (eng): implementation notes: rerank currently accepts array of candidates up to 100. customers ask for batching 10 queries x 1k candidates total. we should cap server work and add per-request candidate_limit + global throttle. proposed API snippet:

```json
{
  "queries": ["q1", "q2"],
  "candidates": [ ... ],
  "candidate_limit": 200,   // server will truncate client list
  "normalize_scores": "softmax" // optional: [none, softmax, minmax]
}
```

nina (ml): normalize_scores choices matter. softmax across mixed-length candidate lists can blow up. add param "temperature" and document behavior. default: none.

maya (PM): acceptance criteria draft: 
- API accepts optional params without breaking existing clients.
- Latency SLO: 95p end-to-end for rerank (single-query, 100 candidates) <= 120ms on dedicated pool.
- Embeddings degradation guard: mean drift <0.03 vs baseline.
- Rollout plan: canary 5% traffic for 48h + metric checks.

sam (growth): we need an explicit migration email & changelog blurb. also add a sandbox example for multi-query rerank — our top trial customers will try that first.

eli (design): example for chat streaming change (add metadata toggle):

```http
POST /v1/chat.create
Content-Type: application/json
{ "model":"rwd-chat-1", "messages": [...], "rich_metadata": true }
```

arjun (eng): edge cases to list in RFC: 
- empty candidate lists (return 400)
- >candidate_limit behavior (truncate + warning field in response)
- mixed-encoding text (normalize to NFC before scoring)
- streaming + rich_metadata: chunk boundary rules (must attach metadata header only on first chunk)

nina (ml): add test harness: deterministic microbench with seeded candidates and synthetic perturbations (typos, length extremes). will share Jupyter with eval steps.

ops-bot: deploy-checker: "canary job queued: rerank-canary-v1 on dedicated-prod-3" :gear:

maya (PM): next steps: arjun to update spec with candidate_limit + normalize_scores options; nina to add eval thresholds; eli to add request/response examples; i'll draft rollout checklist and changelog. aim for doc freeze EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

arjun (eng): on it. will PR a short schema patch and compatibility note.

nina (ml): will upload eval notebook by EOD.

eli (design): will add examples and minimal diagrams.

maya (PM): thanks everyone. if any blockers pop up drop them here or ping me directly.

(reacts summary): :thumbsup: from arjun, nina, eli; :eyes: from sam
